title: Ethiopian Dabo Kolo Sweet
localName: ጣፋጭ ዳቦ ቆሎ — Tafach Dabo Kolo
community: All of Ethiopia — the sweet Dabo Kolo for dessert
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Ethiopian Sweet Dabo Kolo — the sweeter, richer dessert version of the traditional crunchy Dabo Kolo (ETH162). Made with more honey, less flour, and the addition of sesame seeds. Served as a dessert sweet with coffee rather than a snack.
longDesc: The sweet Dabo Kolo for dessert is richer and more indulgent than the snack version — more honey, sesame seeds for texture, and the full Ethiopian spice profile of cardamom and cinnamon.
steps: See ETH162 for base method — add egg, more honey, and sesame seeds.
Mix all ingredients to a firm dough.
Roll into ropes. Cut into 1cm pieces.
Bake at 170°C 22—25 minutes until golden and completely crisp.
chefTips: Richer than standard Dabo Kolo — must still be completely crisp.
servedWith: With Ethiopian coffee as a dessert
culturalNote: Sweet Dabo Kolo is the dessert table version of the snack basket version — the same form, elevated by more honey and sesame into something that earns its place after a meal.
